items.q: Should firing your gun stop a sprint, the way aiming already does?
opts: No, fire loose on the run
items.note: Aiming cuts the sprint since your 10-20 order; firing does not.

items.q: Should pressing crouch in the middle of a sprint turn into a short slide?
items.note: Sprint, roll and crouch otherwise stay as they are (your 10-12 answer).

items.q: When your health is low, should your pillager move slower?
items.note: Health already comes back slowly 10 s after a fight.

items.q: How fast should switching guns feel?
While you bandage or use a medkit, how should you move?
What should a close blast do to your pillager?
opts: A stagger that throws off aim
items.note: The per-gun kicks and hit shoves stay (your 3.31 a).

items.q: When you focus aim, how far ahead should the camera reach?
items.note: Look-ahead stays (your 10-15 answer); this is only the focus aim push.

items.q: Should the gun in your hands change how fast you move?
items.note: No bag weight, ever; this is only the gun in your hands.

items.q: What should taking a hit do to your sprint?
When you reload a half-full magazine, what happens to the rounds still in it?
items.note: Ammo stays one shared pool (your 10-12 answer).

items.q: What should a missed active reload cost you?
items.note: Guns never jam; this only slows the one reload.

items.q: Should bullets hit softer at long range?
opts: No, same damage at any range
items.note: Time to kill up close stays as it is.

items.q: Should a close shotgun blast shove enemies back?
How should the crowbar swing work?
opts: Third swing in a row hits hardest
items.note: Melee one-shots crawlers and breaks walls today.

items.q: Should a finisher on a downed pillager bot give you something back?
opts: Ammo for the gun in hand

items.q: Should elite long-gun pillager bots show a glint just before their big shot?
opts: A glint plus an aim lane
items.note: An elite longshot bot hits for 272 from up to 580 away.

items.q: In a normal raid, how often should you run low on ammo?
opts: Now and then, by mid raid
items.note: How much loot is out there stays as it is (your 10-12 answer).

items.q: When you fire fast, should the aim point drift off target, or only the spread widen?
items.note: The bloom ring already shows the spread.

items.q: Should a decoy beacon also pull the Overseer away?
When a heavy machine you cannot see is about to fire at you, how should you be warned?
opts: Red streak at your feet, edge marker
items.note: Your 2.59 a: heavies warn half a second ahead; unseen ones only sound.

items.q: What should the golden enemy do when it gets hurt?
items.note: A golden enemy shows up every raid with big loot.

items.q: What should badly hurt pillager bots do?
In two-player raids, who should the Overseer go after?
Should a few machines start asleep, so you can sneak past or ambush them?
When machines attack, what should nearby pillager bots do about you?
items.note: Machines and pillager bots already fight each other.

items.q: Should destroyed big machines leave a wreck you can hide behind?
items.note: Bodies stay gone; this is about machine wrecks only.

items.q: How should pillager bots react to a grenade landing near them?
Which guns should pillager bots carry?
items.note: Pillager bot roles already show by outfit tint.

items.q: Should the forge sit in the same spot every raid, or move?
Should the forge have machines guarding it?
opts: No, it is a safe spot

items.q: After you pick a forge element, can you change it later?
Should the forge also upgrade the crowbar, with its own element?
Should guns found up top roll small random perks, like a faster reload?
opts: No, every copy is the same
items.note: Rarity colours are green, blue, purple and gold.

items.q: Should a door key last forever, or wear out?
items.note: Keys are rare loot that open the locked rooms.

items.q: Should the best gear come only from raids, or also from the shop?
opts: The shop sells everything, at a price
items.note: Shop stock re-rolls each raid (your 10-14 pick).

items.q: What should happen to items you mark as junk?
opts: They sell themselves after each raid
items.note: Selling is right-click and sell today.

items.q: Should you be able to craft at a bench up top during a raid?
How many maps should the full game have?
opts: Cold storage plus the cold mile
items.note: Only cold storage is on today; the others are locked.

items.q: Should cold storage hide secret rooms behind walls you can break?
items.note: The crowbar already breaks walls.

items.q: Should you be able to shoot out lights to make dark corners?
opts: Yes, lights can be shot out

items.q: Should extractions differ in risk and reward?
opts: No, every exit pays the same
One hot exit pays triple SP
items.note: Extracting doubles the score today.

items.q: Should you choose where you ascend on the map?
items.note: The pre-raid page opens on the map (your pick a).

items.q: Where should the richest loot sit?
After a big fight, how should the waves behave?
items.note: Waves grow the longer you stay (your 10-13 answer).

items.q: Should machines come looking for pillagers who camp in one spot too long?
At night, should pillagers carry a light they can switch off to hide?
items.note: Nights are darker and moodier (your 10-12 answer).

items.q: While you watch your partner after extracting, may you still ping danger for them?
items.note: Your 2.25 b: the first one out watches the partner live.

items.q: In two-player raids, where should the pair ascend?
opts: Apart, a short walk to meet

items.q: Should reviving your partner use up a bandage?
opts: Optional: a bandage makes it faster
items.note: Partners can revive each other any number of times (your 3.19 a).

items.q: How should a downed partner get to cover?
opts: You can carry them at walking pace

items.q: Should one button drop some ammo at your partner's feet?
opts: No, drop it from the backpack
items.note: Sharing is dropping on the floor (your 10-03 ruling).

items.q: What should you see of your partner on your own screen?
When one player is out, should the last pillager standing get a bonus?
Should a ping on an enemy keep following it for a few seconds?
Should pillagers get a few silent gestures, like a wave and a thumbs up?
items.note: No spoken sounds anywhere still stands.

items.q: When your partner finds something rare, should you hear it on your TV too?
In a two-player career raid, how should the credits work?
items.note: Stashes stay separate (your 2.89 a).

items.q: On a pad, should sprint be a hold or a toggle?
opts: Toggle on pad, hold on keys
items.note: Holding a stick click down to run tires the thumb.

items.q: On a pad, how should the aim distance be set?
opts: By how far you push the stick
A fixed reach, the d-pad changes it
Fixed reach, focus aim extends it
items.note: Today the d-pad left and right set the aim distance.

items.q: Which pad preset should a brand new player start on?
items.note: Six presets exist, all twin stick.

items.q: On a pad, how should a grenade throw work?
opts: Hold to show the arc, release
Tap throws at the aim point

items.q: What should the pad's d-pad left and right do?
On keyboard, should one key roll on a tap and sprint on a hold?
Should one key swap straight back to your last gun?
opts: No, the number keys are enough
items.note: Every gun has its own key today (1 to 8, and 0).

items.q: When a pad player lets go of the aim stick, where should the aim point go?
Should a double tap on a move key roll that way?
The hud size row (large for tv) does nothing today. Should it really grow the raid HUD?
items.note: The demo already has tv-size text on by default (your Q21).

items.q: Should harder rule settings, like more bots or harder hits, pay more SP?
items.note: Easy mode already cuts points 30 percent (your 2.47 c).

items.q: Should a superhot run count on the scoreboard?
Should every hold action (loot, extract, revive) have a tap option in Settings?
Should the crosshair dim when your target is out of your gun's range?
What should a hardcore view in Settings show?
Should Settings let you swap the mouse buttons for left-handed play?
Should Settings offer a slower game speed for new players?
items.note: Easy mode cuts damage 30 percent and gives a free medkit.

items.q: How should the game warn that your magazine is nearly empty?
opts: A lighter click on the last rounds
Both, plus the bar turns red

items.q: Should regular machines show a health bar, or only smoke and sparks?
opts: Smoke and sparks only, as now
items.note: Machines smoke at half health and spark near death today.

items.q: Should fast hits on one enemy merge into one growing damage number?
Should the kill feed show the gun or element that got the kill?
How should your pillager show armour wearing down in a raid?
opts: Plates fall off as they break

items.q: Should a loud fight just off screen show a soft glow at that screen edge?
items.note: Red noise rings show unseen sounds within earshot.

items.q: Should the raid clock tick softly in the last ten seconds?
opts: No, the red clock is enough
items.note: The last 60 s already bring a sting and a red clock.

items.q: How should enemy shots look next to your own?
opts: Enemy tracers in a warning colour

items.q: Should an arriving wave show an arrow at the screen edge when it lands off screen?
opts: No, the ground telegraph is enough

items.q: Should the demo raid map list the run goals, like the career map lists contracts?
opts: No, goals stay on the HUD
items.note: The career map lists every contract (your Q1).

items.q: Should contracts pay out guns or cosmetics as well as $?
opts: Cosmetics only for the big ones

items.q: Where should rare cosmetics come from?
items.note: Cosmetics are earned in play (your 09-03 answer).

items.q: Should the Undercroft get a small shooting range to try guns?
The Undercroft has many stations. Should some merge to make it simpler?
items.note: You called the Undercroft too complicated on 10-12.

items.q: What should happen to a hired merc who survives the raid?
opts: He stays for a fee each raid

items.q: Should your hired merc go where you ping?
Should career offer an optional hardcore save where one death wipes the stash?
items.note: Death already empties what you carried.

items.q: How should contracts fit together?
opts: A short chain with a story
Chains only for the big rewards

items.q: Before a demo run, should the two players walk the Undercroft together, or start at once?
opts: Start at once, side by side
items.note: Your H1 b and 3.4 a disagree; today it starts at once.

items.q: When a guest takes the top spot on the board, how big should that moment be?
Should the night have small extra boards, like most kills and most $?
opts: Yes, two or three side boards

items.q: Should each board row show the gun that pillager used most?
Should the board show how each run ended?
Should the run-over card give each player a fun title, like crowbar maniac?
items.note: The card shows the crown plus two moments (your 2.48 b).

items.q: Should a demo run that ends in the first minute get one free retry?
Should the waiting screen show one fact about the night, like the longest streak?
